name: MA Research Project Part - I
description: In the major project, students will write a dissertation on the special topic chosen in consultation with a supervisor. This part of project will train students to: select a substantive topic of study and identify the literature and the debates in the chosen area of study; preparing a broad matrix for the literature of the topic chosen and debates around it; preparing an annotated bibliography; reading to build the research proposal.
